name: University of Nottingham
summary: A large campus university at University Park, Nottingham, with about 400 courses and its own campuses in Malaysia and China as study-abroad options.

ib.text: Offers are either a points total or grades in three HL subjects, e.g. 36 points or 7,6,6 at HL for Economics (AAA courses: 34 points). HL 7 counts as an A-level A*, 6 as an A.

dates.label: UCAT (Medicine): last day to sit the test
UCAS deadline for Medicine, 18:00 UK time
UCAS equal consideration deadline (all other courses), 18:00 UK time

notes: Without UK settled or pre-settled status you pay the international fee: £27,600 a year for Economics and International Economics, £48,900 for Medicine, for 2027 entry.
Because offers can be met through three HL subjects alone, strong HL grades can carry you even if your total points fall short.
Medicine interviews for 2027 entry run from 15 December 2026 to 29 January 2027, online for international applicants.
